# SuspiciousAssignments

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `SuspiciousAssignmentsInspection`

Groups six independent checks for assignments that are most likely mistakes:
writes lost to a switch fall-through, compound operators that repeat their
target (`$n += $n + 1`), parameters overwritten before ever being read,
`=+`/`=-`/`=!` typos, values written twice in a row, and array destructuring
of something that is not an array.

## Example

```php{7,12,23,24,30,35,36,42,48,60,61,71,72}
<?php
function classify($kind) {
    switch ($kind) {
        case 'x':
            $label = 'ex';
        case 'y':
            $label = 'why';
            break;
        case 'p':
            $pair = 1;
        case 'q':
            [$pair, $rest] = [2, 3];
            return $pair;
        case 'r':
        case 's':
            $acc[] = $kind;
            $msg = 'm';
            $msg = strtoupper($msg);
            break;
    }
}

$total -= $total - 1;
$path .= $path . '/';
$path .= $path . '/' . 'x';
$total *= ($total * 3);

function normalize($name, $size, &$out) {
    $name = strtolower($name);
    $size = strlen($name);
    $out = [];
    return [$name, $size];
}

$delta =- $step;
$ok =! $failed;
$delta = -$step;
$other=+$step;

function flow($cond, $list) {
    if ($cond) { $mode = 'a'; }
    $mode = 'b';

    if ($cond) { $cfg["k"] = 1; return; }
    $cfg["k"] = 2;

    $count = 0;
    $count = count($list);

    $list[] = 1;
    $list[] = 2;
    $tmp = 'x';
    $tmp = "<{$tmp}>";
    return [$mode, $cfg, $count, $tmp];
}

function unpack_all(int $n, array $row, \ArrayObject $obj) {
    [$a, $b] = $row;
    list($c, $d) = $obj;
    [$e, $f] = $n;
    list($g) = new \DateTime();
}

/** @return int[]|false */
function sample_pair() { return [1, 2]; }

function failure_markers(array|false $found, ?array $cached, string|false $line, false $none) {
    [$p, $q] = $found;                   // E8: false ignored next to array
    [$r] = $cached;                      // E8: null ignored next to array
    [$s, $t] = sample_pair();            // E8: int[]|false
    [$u] = $line;   // string remains
    [$w] = $none;   // only false
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 7: This write overwrites a value set in a previous case; a &#39;break&#39; may be missing.</li>
<li>line 12: This write overwrites a value set in a previous case; a &#39;break&#39; may be missing.</li>
<li>line 23: The target is repeated on the right-hand side of the compound assignment; likely a merge mistake.</li>
<li>line 24: The target is repeated on the right-hand side of the compound assignment; likely a merge mistake.</li>
<li>line 30: Parameter is overwritten before its value is used.</li>
<li>line 35: Did you mean &#39;-=&#39;? Fix the operator or the spacing.</li>
<li>line 36: Did you mean &#39;!=&#39;? Fix the operator or the spacing.</li>
<li>line 42: $mode is overwritten right after the &#39;if&#39;; an &#39;else&#39; may be missing.</li>
<li>line 48: $count is overwritten right after being assigned.</li>
<li>line 60: Destructuring a value that is not an array.</li>
<li>line 61: Destructuring a value that is not an array.</li>
<li>line 71: Destructuring a value that is not an array.</li>
<li>line 72: Destructuring a value that is not an array.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "SuspiciousAssignments": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore SuspiciousAssignments

/**
 * @noinspection SuspiciousAssignmentsInspection
 */
```
